most_important_change_diversity.formula: S'(c) = S_hybrid(c, u) - lambda * P(c, R)
most_important_change_diversity.penalty_term: P(c, R) = count(c.category in R) / max(1, |R|)
most_important_change_diversity.why_changed: The old codebase used ad-hoc hard category caps and legacy multiplicative filters that diverged from Equation (14) in the manuscript. Step 1 implemented Equation (14) in backend/app/ai/diversity_service.py and unified both production and evaluation pipelines.

context_aware_improvement.nuance: Context features actively refine scoring and shift candidate positions in 73.53% of recommendation sessions. However, macro-averaged MRR@10 and NDCG@10 show subtle overall differences, so context is characterized as 'refining candidate ranking' rather than 'producing a massive macro metric jump'.

neural_ranker_contribution.contribution_summary: The neural ranker provides substantial, statistically significant performance improvements over the heuristic baseline Model E across all 11 evaluation metrics.

hybrid_ranking_status.note: This hybrid scoring structure was already present in the codebase prior to Steps 1-5.

ablation_findings_summary.honest_interpretation: Both context and diversity mechanisms are active and alter rankings in over 72% of impressions. Diversity Eq. (14) increases unique categories in Top-10 from 4.96 to 5.16 (+0.20 per list) and improves ILD@10 from 0.9270 to 0.9287 without sacrificing ranking accuracy.

diversity_mechanism_evidence.top1_unchanged_reason: Under greedy selection, the first item (R = empty) incurs penalty P(c, empty) = 0, so Top-1 is selected purely by base hybrid score.

statistical_validation_summary.supplementary_per_user: N = 500 disjoint users | 8/11 metrics Holm-significant (P@10, R@5, R@10 have Holm p = 0.0523)

latency_benchmark_summary.nature_of_fix: EVALUATION FIX (Reconciled manuscript claims with empirical measurements)
